acceptanceCriteria.text: Parent-directory open/fsync/close failures after successful rename cannot be reported as an ordinary pre-effect replacement failure.
The caller can deterministically distinguish pre-effect failure from post-effect durability uncertainty.
Documentation/comments state the exact atomicity vs durability guarantees.
Fault-injection coverage includes `*.directory.open`, `*.directory.sync`, and `*.directory.close` after rename.
Tests assert the actual destination bytes for every post-rename failure point.
Existing temp-file cleanup and mode-preservation behavior remains unchanged.

issue.title: fix: distinguish post-rename durability failure from pre-effect atomic replacement failure
